map.网格尺寸限 4-24，越界报错；8×8 时载入预置笑脸位图（置 1 处填 #F5: Grid size is limited to 4-24 and out-of-range values report an error; at 8×8 a preset smiley bitmap loads (cells set to 1 are filled with #F59E0B), other sizes start empty; canvas cells are 32px with a 2px gap and columns = grid size; character-art preview marks filled cells ■ and empty cells ·; clicking paints with the current color and erase restores #e2e8f0
map.网格 4–24 可调，颜色从固定 6 色中选择；点击格子把当前颜色写入二维数组，: Grid size ranges from 4 to 24 and colors come from a fixed set of six. Clicking a cell writes the current color into a 2-D array, which feeds the character-art preview and the CSS box-shadow export. The page does not read images or perform automatic pixelation or color quantization.

map.支持导入图片自动像素化吗？: Can it import a photo and pixelate it automatically?
